add.title: ✅ ext/Refine explained
add.text: How it works: /framework/ext/Refine/doc/how-it-works.md. RefineSystem runs everything and uses Prompt, Scorer and Whisper. Two steps: clean (Haiku splits the prompt into sentences S1..Sn, with a quick clean on every chunk), then refine (an outline with citations, which Outline turns into cards). The Dictate path: Capture, then Dictate, then Whisper, then ComposerMic, then RefineSystem, then VoicePage. Known broken: the dev socket drops and Whisper restarts; a phone needs https to use the mic; Whisper answers can arrive out of order (a sequence check guards this). No logged failure of the jsonl bubble updates was found yet. The proposal (not built) is /framework/ext/Refine/doc/voice-to-refine.md: RemoteMCP saves a long prompt, runs refine in the background and posts the refined card here.

add.text: /framework/ext/Refine/doc/audit-2026-10-15.md. Rules: near-verbatim cleaning is present. Chunking is partial (it cuts at pauses, not sentences). The model's 'S1.' numbering leaked into your text (fixed). The text area clipped at a fixed 3.4em height (fixed). Padding: Page.css:186, side gutter clamp(2em,4%,5em), top and bottom clamp(1.5em,4%,3em); a change is only proposed. Next: a Cleaner class with its page at /framework/ext/Refine/cleaner/. The fixes wait for review before merge.

add.title: Phone feed fixed: live tail stopped
add.text: Cause: the dev socket only opens on localhost (a security guard), so the phone got one fetch and never updated. Fix: off localhost the page now reads only the new bytes of page.jsonl every 3 s while visible, and again when the tab becomes visible, regains focus or the network returns; the feed is sorted strictly by time, newest first. Checked headless at 400 and 1200 wide: a card appended with no reload showed up. Notes: /live/doc/notes.md.
